Application Data.NAME: CoolAir Solutions Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CoolAir Solutions Inc. specializes in the sale, installation, and servicing of air conditioning and heating systems for residential and commercial properties. Our operations include conducting system assessments, offering maintenance plans, and providing emergency repair services. We also manufacture select components for HVAC systems to support our installations and ensure high-quality performance. Our team is highly trained and experienced in the latest technologies and energy-efficient solutions, ensuring customer satisfaction and compliance with industry standards.
